inj.note: Lock continues to deal with a right elbow injury, and he's also tending to an oblique issue that he suffered this past Sunday against the Cardinals. He discussed the new health concern Thursday, telling reporters Fox 13 Seattle that he's "feeling good" and the oblique injury is on his backside, which is easier to deal with than if it was on the lead side. Lock so far has had his practice reps capped this week as a result, and Friday's injury report will determine if he enters the weekend with a designation for Sunday's game at Las Vegas.

news.h: Drew Lock set to start vs. Raiders
news.d: Report: Drew Lock is set to start against the Raiders in Week 10 despite dealing with injuries.

news.h: Seahawks to start QB Drew Lock vs. Raiders, giving Sam Darnold more time to heal
news.d: The Seahawks plan to start quarterback Drew Lock on Sunday against the Raiders, giving Sam Darnold more time to recover from his injuries.

news.h: Drew Lock overcomes oblique injury in fill-in start for Sam Darnold, Seahawks
news.d: Already dealing with an injury to his throwing elbow, Drew Lock hurt his oblique in the third quarter of Seattle's 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals at Lumen Field.

news.h: Seahawks' Lock says elbow feeling 'better' ahead of start vs. Cardinals
news.d: Seattle Seahawks backup quarterback Drew Lock, who's in line to start this week with Sam Darnold sidelined, says the elbow injury that made him inactive for the past two games is "doing a lot better."
